finding.title: Release baseline_raw on the first predicate exception
finding.evidence: Both models, each of original_n/grid/cache_original_N/missing_grid: retained original traceback does not retain the returned baseline raw; candidate retains its tiny8KiB payload until traceback.clear_frames. Later geometry failure after del releases baseline.
finding.cause: _require rejection or missing-key error exits before del baseline_raw; the function traceback owns the new local reference.
finding.minimum_candidate_repair: Keep one authenticated rows read and the three same predicates; wrap only the baseline predicate evaluation/_require in try/finally with del baseline_raw so rejection and KeyError release the local reference.
finding.production_relevance_limit: A retained traceback can extend the full returned raw lifetime.
